name: Natural numbers
meaning: Counting numbers 0, 1, 2, … (check whether your class includes 0).

name: Positive integers
meaning: Natural numbers except 0; used as a denominator in a fraction.

name: Rational numbers
meaning: Numbers that can be written a/b with a integer and b a positive integer.

name: Real numbers
meaning: All rationals and irrationals; every point on the number line.

name: Positive reals
meaning: Real numbers strictly greater than 0. Bases of logs and many roots live here.

name: Complex numbers
meaning: Numbers z = a + ib with a, b real. S6 introduces the algebraic form.

name: Element of
meaning: x ∈ A means x belongs to the set A.

name: Not an element
meaning: x ∉ A means x does not belong to A. Example from S4: √2 ∉ ℚ.

name: Empty set
meaning: The set with no elements. Also called the null set.

name: Subset
meaning: Every element of A is an element of B.

name: Set complement
meaning: Elements of the universal set that are not in A.

name: Cartesian product
meaning: Ordered pairs (a, b) with a in A and b in B.

name: Cardinal number
meaning: How many elements a finite set has. Power set of a finite set has 2^|A| subsets.

name: Pi
meaning: Circle constant; also the radian measure of a half-turn (180°).

name: Base e
meaning: Base of the natural exponential; y = e^x solves y' = y with y(0) = 1.

name: Infinity
meaning: Used in limits, improper integrals, and unbounded intervals.

name: Closed interval
meaning: All reals from a to b, including both ends.

name: Open interval
meaning: All reals strictly between a and b. EB uses reversed brackets, not (a, b).

name: Half-open interval
meaning: From a up to but not including b. ]a, b] excludes a and includes b.

name: Discriminant
meaning: For ax² + bx + c: Δ = b² − 4ac. Sign of Δ tells how many real roots.

name: Difference
meaning: Change in a quantity: Δx = x₂ − x₁.

name: Summation
meaning: Σ adds a list of terms, from a start index to an end index.

name: Function value
meaning: Output of f at input x. Also written x ↦ f(x).

name: Maps to
meaning: The rule that sends input x to output f(x).

name: Absolute value
meaning: Distance from 0; √(a²) = |a|.

name: Square root
meaning: Non-negative number whose square is a. Inverse of squaring on [0, ∞[.

name: nth root
meaning: Number whose nth power is a. Same as a^{1/n}.

name: Scientific notation
meaning: A number written as a product of a coefficient and a power of ten.

name: Logarithm
meaning: The exponent that turns b into a. S5 uses a positive integer base.

name: Common logarithm
meaning: Logarithm base 10. S6 lists log, ln and lb among the basic functions.

name: Natural logarithm
meaning: Logarithm base e; inverse of the natural exponential.

name: Binary logarithm
meaning: Logarithm base 2. Named lb in the S6 5P basic-function list.

name: Approximately equal
meaning: Used when a value is rounded or a model is not exact.

name: Not equal
meaning: The two sides are different.

name: Factorial
meaning: Product 1 × 2 × … × n. Counts permutations of n distinct objects.

name: Binomial coefficient
meaning: n choose k: ways to choose k from n, unordered. Also Pascal’s triangle entries.

name: Term of a sequence
meaning: The nth term. May start at u_0 or u_1, as defined. Explicit: u_n = f(n).

name: Imaginary unit
meaning: i² = −1. A complex number is written z = a + ib.

name: Complex conjugate
meaning: If z = a + ib then z̄ = a − ib.

name: Modulus of z
meaning: Distance from 0 in the complex plane: |z| = √(a² + b²).

name: Argument of z
meaning: Angle of z in (−π, π]. Polar form uses r (cos θ + i sin θ).

name: Real and imaginary parts
meaning: Re(a + ib) = a and Im(a + ib) = b.

name: Degree
meaning: 1/360 of a full turn. Full turn = 360°.

name: Radian
meaning: Angle that cuts an arc equal to the radius. Full turn = 2π rad.

name: Angle
meaning: The angle at B formed by points A, B, C.

name: Parallel
meaning: Same direction; never meet. Two vectors are parallel when one is a scalar times the other.

name: Perpendicular
meaning: Orthogonal; meet at a right angle. Two vectors: u · v = 0.

name: Similar
meaning: Same shape, possibly different size. Matching angles equal; sides in proportion.

name: Congruent
meaning: Same shape and size. Can be matched by a rigid motion.

name: Sine, cosine, tangent
meaning: Trig ratios of an oriented angle; on the unit circle the domain is all reals.

name: Inverse trig
meaning: Inverse sine, cosine and tangent. S7 AM uses them to integrate.

name: Vector
meaning: Directed segment from A to B; in the plane it matches an ordered pair of reals.

name: Free vector
meaning: A translation: equal directed segments represent the same free vector.

name: Magnitude
meaning: Length of a vector. Distance AB is the magnitude of AB.

name: Scalar product
meaning: Dot product. Zero means the vectors are orthogonal.

name: Vector product
meaning: Cross product in 3D. Direction by the right-hand rule; magnitude is the parallelogram area.

name: Unit vectors
meaning: Orthonormal basis of 3D space along the x, y and z axes.

name: Line parameter
meaning: Real number in r = a + t d. Each t is a point on the line.

name: Limit
meaning: Value that f(x) approaches as x approaches a (or ±∞).

name: Derivative
meaning: Gradient function. Also written dy/dx. At a point it is the gradient of the tangent.

name: Leibniz derivative
meaning: Same as f'(x). Used from first principles in S6.

name: Second derivative
meaning: Derivative of f'. Sign tells convexity; zeros can be points of inflexion.

name: nth derivative
meaning: Result of differentiating n times. Used in Taylor polynomials.

name: Indefinite integral
meaning: The family of antiderivatives of f: F' = f, written F(x) + C.

name: Definite integral
meaning: F(b) − F(a) when F' = f. Area under a non-negative graph from a to b.

name: Sample space
meaning: Set of all possible outcomes of a random experiment.

name: Probability of A
meaning: Number in [0, 1] giving how likely event A is.

name: Complement
meaning: Outcomes not in A. P(Ā) = 1 − P(A).

name: Conditional probability
meaning: Probability of A given that B has occurred: P(A ∩ B) / P(B).

name: Conditional (index)
meaning: Same as P(A | B); the EB syllabus writes both.

name: Union
meaning: A or B (or both). If mutually exclusive, P(A ∪ B) = P(A) + P(B).

name: Intersection
meaning: A and B. Independent events: P(A ∩ B) = P(A) P(B).

name: Random variable
meaning: A number attached to each outcome. Discrete in S6; continuous in S7.

name: Probability mass
meaning: Probability that a discrete random variable equals a listed value.

name: Cumulative distribution
meaning: Probability that X is at most x.

name: Expected value
meaning: Mean of a random variable. For a binomial, np.

name: Variance
meaning: Spread of a random variable. Standard deviation is √Var(X).

name: Success probability
meaning: Probability of success in one Bernoulli trial; binomial parameter.

name: Mean of a normal
meaning: Expected value of a normal (or other continuous) distribution.

name: Standardised variable
meaning: Turns X ~ N(μ, σ²) into a standard normal.

name: Pearson correlation
meaning: Linear association of a bivariate sample, in [−1, 1]. Calculated with technology.

name: Sample mean
meaning: Average of the observed values in a sample.

name: Median
meaning: Middle value once the data are ordered. Half the observations lie on each side.

name: Mode
meaning: Most frequent value in the data set.

name: Quartiles
meaning: Q₁ is the median of the lower half; Q₃ of the upper half.

name: Interquartile range
meaning: Spread of the middle 50% of the data. Used with a boxplot.

name: Range
meaning: Largest observation minus smallest.

name: Standard deviation
meaning: Spread of a data set around the mean. S5 computes it by hand for n ≤ 6.

name: Sample size
meaning: Number of observations in the sample.

name: Absolute frequency
meaning: How many times a value (or class) occurs.

name: Relative frequency
meaning: Absolute frequency divided by n; a proportion or a percentage.

name: Congruence
meaning: a and b leave the same remainder on division by n (n ≥ 2).

name: Greatest common divisor
meaning: Largest positive integer that divides both a and b. Found by Euclid’s algorithm.

name: Least common multiple
meaning: Smallest positive common multiple. For integers, gcd(a,b) · lcm(a,b) = |ab|.

name: Matrix entry
meaning: a_ij sits in row i and column j of an m × n matrix.

name: Determinant
meaning: A scalar attached to a square matrix. Non-zero means A is invertible.

name: Inverse matrix
meaning: Square matrix with A A^{-1} = I. Exists only when A is non-singular.

name: Transpose
meaning: Rows become columns.

name: Rank
meaning: Dimension of the column space; also the size of the largest non-zero minor.

name: Identity matrix
meaning: Square matrix with 1s on the diagonal and 0s elsewhere.

name: And, or
meaning: Conjunction and disjunction of propositions. Truth tables in S6 AM.

name: Negation
meaning: The proposition that is true exactly when p is false.

name: Implication
meaning: If p then q. False only when p is true and q is false.

name: Equivalence
meaning: p if and only if q. Both true or both false.

name: For all
meaning: Universal quantifier. Negating ∀x P(x) gives ∃x ¬P(x).

name: There exists
meaning: Existential quantifier. Negating ∃x P(x) gives ∀x ¬P(x).

name: Charge
meaning: Quantity of charge. SI unit: coulomb (C).

name: Current
meaning: Charge flow per unit time, I = Q / t. SI unit: ampere (A).

name: Voltage
meaning: Energy per coulomb. EB writes U, not V, in S4 circuits. SI unit: volt (V).

name: Resistance
meaning: R = U / I. SI unit: ohm (Ω).

name: Power
meaning: Rate of energy transfer, P = U I. SI unit: watt (W).

name: Elementary charge
meaning: Magnitude of the charge on a proton or electron: 1.6 × 10^{-19} C.

name: Capacitance
meaning: Q = C U. SI unit: farad (F).

name: Displacement
meaning: Position along a line, or distance moved. Vector or scalar as stated.

name: Velocity
meaning: Rate of change of displacement. Speed is the scalar version.

name: Acceleration
meaning: Rate of change of velocity.

name: Force
meaning: A vector that can change motion. Weight is written F_G = m g.

name: Mass
meaning: How hard it is for a given force to change the motion. SI unit: kilogram.

name: Gravitational field strength
meaning: Force per unit mass. Near Earth, about 9.81 N/kg; also the free-fall acceleration.

name: Work
meaning: Energy transferred by a force, W = F s when s is parallel to F. SI unit: joule.

name: Kinetic energy
meaning: Energy of motion, ½ m v².

name: Potential energy
meaning: Stored energy. Gravitational: ΔE_p = m g Δh in a uniform field.

name: Momentum
meaning: Quantity of motion, p = m v. Conserved in a closed system.

name: Specific heat capacity
meaning: Heat per kilogram per kelvin in Q = m c ΔT.

name: Specific latent heat
meaning: Heat per kilogram to change state, Q = m l.

name: Heat
meaning: Energy transferred because of a temperature difference. Same letter as charge; context tells them apart.

name: Angular velocity
meaning: Rate of change of angle, also 2π f in oscillations. SI unit: rad/s.

name: Period
meaning: Time for one oscillation. f = 1 / T.

name: Frequency
meaning: Oscillations per second. SI unit: hertz (Hz).

name: Wavelength
meaning: Distance between neighbouring corresponding points on a wave.

name: Amplitude
meaning: Maximum displacement from equilibrium.

name: Electric field strength
meaning: Force per unit charge, E = F / q. SI unit: N/C or V/m.

name: Magnetic flux density
meaning: Magnetic field. Force on a wire is B I ℓ sin θ. SI unit: tesla (T).

name: Coulomb constant
meaning: k = 1 / (4π ε_0) in Coulomb’s law and radial E and V.

name: Permittivity of free space
meaning: Constant in k = 1 / (4π ε_0).

name: Permeability (solenoid)
meaning: In B = μ n I inside a solenoid; n = N / ℓ.

name: Gravitational constant
meaning: Newton’s G in F_G = G m₁ m₂ / r².

name: Potential
meaning: Work per unit charge (electric) or per unit mass (gravitational). ΔV = ΔE_p / q or / m.

name: Magnetic flux
meaning: Φ = B_⊥ A. SI unit: weber (Wb).

name: Electromotive force
meaning: Induced emf ε = −ΔΦ / Δt. SI unit: volt.

name: Inductance
meaning: Energy in an inductor is ½ L I². SI unit: henry (H).

name: Activity
meaning: Decays per unit time. S5 uses whole numbers of half-lives, no exponentials.

name: Half-life
meaning: Time for half the nuclei (or the activity) to remain.

name: Planck's constant
meaning: E = h f for a photon; also in de Broglie and uncertainty.

name: Electronvolt
meaning: Energy unit: work on one elementary charge through 1 V.

name: Photon energy
meaning: A quantum of electromagnetic energy.

name: Work function
meaning: Minimum energy to free an electron from a metal surface.

name: Quantum number
meaning: Positive integer labelling energy states (infinite well, hydrogen).

name: Nuclide
meaning: A is mass number, Z is atomic number, X is the element.

name: Speed of light
meaning: Speed of electromagnetic waves in vacuum. In S5: E = m c².

name: Coulomb
meaning: SI unit of charge.

name: Ampere
meaning: SI unit of current.

name: Volt
meaning: SI unit of voltage and of emf.

name: Ohm
meaning: SI unit of resistance. Same glyph as sample space Ω; context tells them apart.

name: Joule
meaning: SI unit of energy and work. 1 kWh is a commercial energy unit in S4.

name: Watt
meaning: SI unit of power: 1 W = 1 J/s.

name: Newton
meaning: SI unit of force: 1 N = 1 kg·m/s².

name: Hertz
meaning: SI unit of frequency: 1 Hz = 1 s⁻¹.

name: Tesla
meaning: SI unit of magnetic flux density B.

name: Kelvin
meaning: SI temperature. Absolute zero is 0 K; T(K) = θ(°C) + 273.

name: Degree Celsius
meaning: Everyday temperature scale in S5 heat.
